thread:
chloe: Drafting a private offer for BlueRidge + Signal Integrators co-sell. Need quick takes on multi-currency pricing, prorated renewal credits, HW rebate ladder, and marketplace SKU bundling. @amar @devon pls
amar: Love the direction. For APAC we need a local-currency SKU and a FX cushion. Suggest 2% FX buffer for orders < $250k.
devon: Sales note: add a small POC bucket ($15k) for SI-led pilots. Make it non-transferable and timeboxed to 60 days.
ryan: Finance: propose three bands with prorated renewal credits (applied as on-invoice credits). Discounts: 7% / 13% / 19% for 40k/300k/1.2M. Renewal credit = min(used-deficit%, cap) prorated monthly; cap 28% of next-year invoice.
claire: Legal flag: HW rebates that ship across borders need export + customs clause, and we should limit appliance credits per account. Also prefer "on-invoice credit" language.
pm-bot: Reminder: attach cost-model when posting margin numbers (template: https://drive.redwood/po-templates/cost-model).
chloe: Quick sample offer below, keeping it concise. Call out blockers only.
```
BlueRidge x Signal Integrators - Private Marketplace Offer (draft)
Bands:
- Starter: $40,000 commit -> 7% discount, $15k POC credits, 6mo activation window
- Business: $300,000 commit -> 13% discount, 10% prorated on-invoice renewal credit, 9mo activation
- Strategic: $1,200,000 commit -> 19% discount, 18% prorated on-invoice renewal credit, 12mo activation
HW rebate ladder: appliance credit $25k/$75k/$200k by band, capped per account; shipment subject to export/customs review
Currency & FX: default USD pricing, option for local-currency SKU in APAC/EU with 2% FX cushion for orders < $250k
Trial bucket: $15k POC credits, non-transferable, expires 60 days
Marketplace SKU mapping: Starter -> public token SKU; Business/Strategic -> reserved-capacity SKUs + private listing for SI deals
Renewal mechanics: on-invoice credit, prorated monthly based on actual usage vs commit, capped at 28% of next-year invoice; unused trial does not count toward commit
GTM: joint case study + partner-listed SKU after first 3 paid customers go-live; co-marketing fund $35k on Strategic commits
```
amar: Quick ask: can we add a clause for FX reconciliation at year-end? avoids surprises.
devon: Sales OK with POC bucket and FX clause. Please ensure trial is gated to named prospects only.
ryan: I'll run blended margin per band and post the sheet by Thu EOD.
claire: I'll draft export/customs language and tweak "on-invoice" clause.
chloe: Great. Action items: @ryan margin calc + sheet, @claire legal redline, @amar confirm local SKU ops, @devon sales gating list. Planning partner sync Wed 11am PT. Thanks everyone.
